context: Compare the full normalized draft payload (including evidence rows) before treating an existing finding as idempotent. Note this necessarily converts some previously-idempotent syncs into conflicts, so decide and document how an evidence-only edit should surface (update in place vs conflict) before implementing.
description:
chatgpt-codex-connector review finding on merged PR #1273 (P2, _project/scripts/todo_findings.py:416). Deferred from the PR-review sweep in PR #1292 because it changes sync/conflict semantics for the findings domain and belongs with that domain work; tracked in GitHub issue #1293.

When a draft with an existing id is edited ONLY in child evidence or other parsed fields outside _CONTENT_FIELDS (evidence, urgency, breadth, confidence, disposition_reason), _finding_matches still returns true, so sync_drafts marks the edited draft .synced and never persists or reports the change. That silently drops audit evidence despite the sync path's same-id/different-content conflict contract.
Thread: https://github.com/joeharris76/BenchBox/pull/1273#discussion_r3634991147

anti_patterns.dont: mark a draft .synced when any parsed field differs from the stored finding
anti_patterns.instead: persist the change or report it as a conflict
anti_patterns.why: that is the silent evidence loss this item fixes

preserves.behavior: A genuinely unchanged draft is still idempotent and still marked .synced
Existing same-id/different-content conflict reporting keeps working

work_units.evidence: Owner decision 2026-07-29: prose (_CONTENT_FIELDS) differences stay a loud conflict; capture-owned payload outside the prose fields resolves as an in-place update recorded in finding_events. Documented in the sync_drafts docstring.
work_units.summary: Decide and document how an evidence-only edit should resolve (in-place update vs reported conflict)

work_units.evidence: Added _EVIDENCE_FIELDS/_normalize_evidence/_evidence_differs/_reconcile_evidence; sync compares normalized evidence rows in order and replaces them in one write txn. Judgement fields deliberately excluded (_DB_OWNED_FIELDS) so a pre-triage draft cannot wipe triage values.
work_units.summary: Compare the full normalized payload including evidence rows in _finding_matches

work_units.evidence: TestSyncFullPayloadComparison: evidence-only edit persisted (not silently synced), reconcile recorded in finding_events, unchanged draft still skipped+marked synced, prose change still raises 'sync conflict', and triage judgement survives a resync. 1115 passed in tests/unit/scripts/.
work_units.summary: Add regression coverage: an evidence-only draft edit is persisted or reported, never silently marked .synced
